sole.DESCRIPTION: Sole, the load cell under Wrist's motor and its HX711, reading the wire's tension. Compiled into Wrist's firmware today, it reports as a device of its own, so it can move. It takes no DMX, so it has no fixture definition and no place in the QLC+ workspace. Out only: nothing is received over OSC.

force_n.DESCRIPTION: The wire's tension, from the raw reading through the coded-in tare and scale.

raw.DESCRIPTION: Each HX711 reading as read, sent once when it arrives: 10 a second, 80 once the RATE leg is lifted.

tare.DESCRIPTION: The coded-in tare: the raw reading with no tension on the wire.

scale.DESCRIPTION: The coded-in scale: the tension one count above the tare stands for, so the force is (raw − tare) · scale. NaN until it is measured.
